author: Intel
description:
Giant LEGO brick replica of the Intel Core Ultra Series 3 Processor to turn AI PC architecture into something you can see, feel, and understand in seconds. 🔹42,000 LEGO bricks 🔹612 LEDs 🔹8ft tall x 4ft wide x 4in thick 🔹280 hours of build time The LEDs are driven in real time by CPU, NPU, and GPU utilization pulled directly from Windows Task Manager, visually demonstrating how AI workloads are distributed across the CPU.
 
Subscribe now to Intel on YouTube: https://intel.ly/3IX1bN2 
 
About Intel:
Intel, the world leader in silicon innovation, develops technologies, products and initiatives to continually advance how people work and live. Founded in 1968 to build semiconductor memory products, Intel introduced the world's first microprocessor in 1971. This decade, our mission is to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth.
